name: IAAtriusPositioning
summary: IndoorAtlas indoor positioning for Atrius (LocusLabs) maps, with train detection.
description: Drives the blue dot on an Atrius (LocusLabs) 2D map using IndoorAtlas indoor positioning. Includes GPS-based train detection: while on a train the blue dot follows raw GPS, and indoor positioning resumes automatically at the next station.
